fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6W7G8 (Fix Review question handles). No owner took part. The planner read internal/api/run_review.go: reviewQuestionHandle builds review-<rid[:8]>-r<round>-<finding>. The first 8 characters of a ULID are only its start time, so plan runs the daemon starts in the same poll share them; runs of 01M6VY7G6HPJ and 01M6VY7GRV7B both added review-01m6vy7e-r3-f1. The handle is also the identity key: reviewQuestionNode reuses a question by handle across change sets, and the asked journal and the autonomous accept gate rebuild it. The planner raised one question: what the handle carries and what happens when it is taken. The arbiter answered with decision review-question-handle-full-run-id (assumed, would have escalated): the full lower-cased run ID; when that handle is taken by another node, take the first free one with uniqueHandle and journal the handle actually used; later checks match by the journal entry. Planned: one leaf, review-question-handle-unique, under plan-workflow, serving milestone-29, whose plan runs hit the collision. Not planned here: the two existing review-01m6vy7e-r3-f1 nodes belong to other unlanded change sets; the intent says to retitle one of them when it lands.
fields.title: Plan of Fix Review question handles (autonomous)
